cards.example_en: Extreme cold forced the football match to stop early.
cards.example_zh: 极端的寒冷迫使足球比赛提前结束。

cards.example_en: Poor eyesight made the distant scoreboard hard for him to read.
cards.example_zh: 视力不好使他很难看清远处的记分牌。

cards.example_en: Actors practice facial expressions so audiences can follow the story.
cards.example_zh: 演员练习面部表情，以便观众能跟上剧情。

cards.example_en: Red flags fade after months of sun and rain on the roof.
cards.example_zh: 屋顶上的红旗经过数月日晒雨淋就会褪色。

cards.example_en: Students pay a reduced fare on city buses before eight o'clock.
cards.example_zh: 八点前，学生乘坐市内公交车可付优惠票价。

cards.example_en: She noticed a broken fingernail after washing dishes for an hour.
cards.example_zh: 她洗了一小时碗后，发现有一根指甲断了。

cards.example_en: A small flame from the candle lit the table during dinner.
cards.example_zh: 蜡烛的一小簇火焰在晚餐时照亮了桌子。

cards.example_en: He carried a flashlight when the power failed in the dormitory.
cards.example_zh: 宿舍停电时，他带着一只手电筒。

cards.example_en: Families had to flee the coast before the storm reached land.
cards.example_zh: 风暴登陆前，家家户户不得不逃离海岸。

cards.example_en: Sunlight made the peach flesh sweet and juicy within a week.
cards.example_zh: 日照让桃子的果肉在一周内变得又甜又多汁。

cards.example_en: Daily conversation practice built her fluency in spoken French.
cards.example_zh: 每天的会话练习培养了她说法语的流利程度。

cards.example_en: Library rules forbid food near the computers and the rare books.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆规定禁止在电脑和珍本书附近吃东西。

cards.example_en: Nobody could foresee how quickly the new club would grow.
cards.example_zh: 没有人能预见这个新社团会发展得这么快。

cards.example_en: We visited Uncle for a fortnight during the summer holiday.
cards.example_zh: 暑假期间我们在叔叔家住了两星期。

cards.example_en: Good fortune and hard work both helped him open the shop.
cards.example_zh: 好运和勤奋都帮助他开了这家店。

cards.example_en: Group projects foster cooperation among students with different skills.
cards.example_zh: 小组项目促进技能不同的学生之间的合作。

cards.example_en: Those fragile glass tubes must stay upright in the lab cabinet.
cards.example_zh: 那些易碎的玻璃管必须在实验室柜子里直立放置。

cards.example_en: Fresh herbs made the kitchen fragrant while she baked the bread.
cards.example_zh: 她烤面包时，新鲜香草让厨房变得芳香四溢。

cards.example_en: This framework for the report keeps my ideas in order.
cards.example_zh: 这个报告框架让我的思路保持清楚。

cards.example_en: At the old station bookstall, that postcard cost one franc.
cards.example_zh: 在旧车站的书摊上，那张明信片售价一法郎。

cards.example_en: Traffic on the freeway slowed after a truck lost a tire.
cards.example_zh: 一辆卡车掉了一只轮胎后，高速公路上的车流慢了下来。

cards.example_en: She made frequent visits to the clinic until her cough disappeared.
cards.example_zh: 她频繁去诊所，直到咳嗽消失。

cards.example_en: Please put the milk back in the refrigerator after breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早饭后请把牛奶放回冰箱。

cards.example_en: Hundreds attended the funeral of the doctor who served the town.
cards.example_zh: 数百人参加了那位为小镇服务的医生的葬礼。

cards.example_en: They rented a furnished room near campus for the first semester.
cards.example_zh: 第一学期他们在校园附近租了一间带家具的房间。

cards.example_en: Farmers stored a gallon of fresh milk in the cool shed.
cards.example_zh: 农民把一加仑新鲜牛奶存放在阴凉的棚子里。

cards.example_en: Each garment on the rack was checked for loose buttons.
cards.example_zh: 架子上的每件衣服都检查过是否有松动的纽扣。

cards.example_en: Friends supported their gay classmate and treated him with respect.
cards.example_zh: 朋友们支持他们的同性恋同学，并以尊重相待。

cards.example_en: Afternoon glare on the river made the rowers shield their eyes.
cards.example_zh: 午后河面上的刺眼强光使划船的人遮住了眼睛。

cards.example_en: Winning the city championship let the team share the glory.
cards.example_zh: 赢得全市冠军后，队员们得以分享这份荣誉。

cards.example_en: Citizens elect leaders who govern the country and protect its laws.
cards.example_zh: 公民选举治理国家并维护法律的领导人。

cards.example_en: A gradual change in temperature kept the plants healthy all spring.
cards.example_zh: 温度的逐渐变化让植物整个春天都保持健康。

cards.example_en: Her graduation from high school brought the whole family together.
cards.example_zh: 她高中毕业，使全家人聚到了一起。

cards.example_en: Outside his shop, the greengrocer arranged fresh peaches and greens.
cards.example_zh: 果蔬商在店门外摆上了新鲜的桃子和青菜。

cards.example_en: On Sundays they grill fish and corn in the small backyard.
cards.example_zh: 每到星期天，他们就在小后院烤鱼和玉米。

cards.example_en: Our local grocer still sells rice, oil, and soap on the corner.
cards.example_zh: 我们当地的杂货商仍在街角出售米、油和肥皂。

cards.example_en: Basketball games and morning classes fill the new gymnasium.
cards.example_zh: 篮球赛和晨练课把新体育馆安排得很满。

cards.example_en: Years of hardship taught the family to share food and hope.
cards.example_zh: 多年的困苦教会这家人分享食物与希望。

cards.example_en: Clean energy research made the morning headline across the city.
cards.example_zh: 清洁能源研究成了全市的早间头条。

cards.example_en: A stone caught in her heel slowed her during the campus walk.
cards.example_zh: 一颗石子卡在她的脚后跟里，让她在校园里走得很慢。

cards.example_en: Every cyclist must wear a helmet before entering the busy road.
cards.example_zh: 每位骑车人进入繁忙道路前都必须戴头盔。

cards.example_en: Hang your coat on the hook beside the classroom door.
cards.example_zh: 把外套挂在教室门边的钩子上。

cards.example_en: Dogs howl at night when fireworks burst over the neighborhood.
cards.example_zh: 烟花在街区上空炸开时，狗会在夜里嚎叫。

cards.example_en: Every human being needs food, safety, and a place to learn.
cards.example_zh: 每一个人都需要食物、安全和一个学习的地方。

cards.example_en: Visitors must show identification before entering the research building.
cards.example_zh: 参观者进入研究楼之前必须出示身份证件。

cards.example_en: Long queues formed at immigration after the international flight landed.
cards.example_zh: 国际航班降落之后，入境处排起了长队。

cards.example_en: The parade marks independence with flags along the main street.
cards.example_zh: 游行用主街两旁的旗帜纪念独立。

cards.example_en: Please insert the key and turn it slowly to open the gate.
cards.example_zh: 请把钥匙插入，慢慢转动以打开大门。

cards.example_en: Solving riddles together tested our intelligence and our patience.
cards.example_zh: 一起猜谜既考验了我们的智力，也考验了耐心。

cards.example_en: People stretched during the interval before the second act.
cards.example_zh: 第二幕开始前的间隔时间里，人们伸了伸懒腰。

word.example_en: Few students make a fortune at a school fair.
word.example_zh: 很少有学生在校园义卖上发一笔财。
